items.t: Valve springs can break and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace all valve springs

items.t: Engine knock or failure after the valve spring recall repair
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of about $5,000 to $17,000; CarComplaints owners average about $6,700.

items.t: Engine knock or sudden engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $9,000 for a 2015 engine replacement.

items.t: Rough idle or stalling with cam timing codes
items.job: Update engine computer; replace cam sprocket/actuator if needed

items.t: Clutch release bearing noise or failure
items.job: Replace clutch kit with new release bearing

items.t: Fuel pump chirp, whine or failure
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump or high-pressure fuel pump

items.t: Ignition coil failure causes misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coil (one)
items.note: Coils on the boxer engine sit low on the sides, so labor varies by cylinder.

items.t: Power steering binds, clunks or loses assist
items.job: Repair or replace electric power steering column/motor
items.note: One owner reported a quote over $900 for the motor alone.

items.t: Fuel pump clicks off early when filling up
items.job: Replace EVAP charcoal canister or vent valve
items.note: One owner reported a quote over $1,700.

items.t: Key can be removed when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reconnect key interlock wiring

items.t: Spare tire may be underinflated (recall)
items.job: Inspect and inflate spare tire

items.t: In-tank fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace low-pressure fuel pump

items.t: Engine failure from sealant clogging the oil pickup
items.job: Remove oil pan, clean pickup and reseal (engine replacement if damaged)
items.note: If bearings are already damaged, owners report engine replacement estimates from about $8,000 to well over $20,000.

items.t: Oil pressure drops during hard cornering on track
items.job: Install oil pressure gauge/sensor (baffled pan optional)
items.note: If a bearing has already spun, the fix is an engine replacement.

items.t: Rear turn signals stop working in bright sun (recall)
items.job: Replace both rear combination lamps

items.t: Remote start and app features stop working
items.job: Activate or reprogram data communication module
items.note: Done by Toyota dealers under a service bulletin, usually at no charge.

items.t: Fuel lines rub through their covers under the hood
items.job: Reposition and protect fuel lines; replace damaged line

items.t: Oil leak from spark plug tube seals
items.job: Replace spark plug tube seals and valve cover gaskets

items.t: Load capacity label shows the wrong weight (recall)
items.job: Install corrected load capacity label

items.t: Blind spot alerts late or missing
items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate or replace blind spot radar sensor
